reviews.text: I purchased lots of items from them in the past several years.  Recently I added a few items into my cart and the next day I was ready to checkout and the items increased in price significantly.  This is poor customer approach.  I will be reassessing purchasing from them again.

I've been a supporter of Primecables for years, mostly because is was told they carried the same products as Monoprice in the States (they carry very few things, especially now in 2025) but i found their prices were amazing and they USED to stand behind their products and offer a lifetime guarantee.  Well, that's all changed in 2025.  Now it's a fight to warranty a product and i find they make false advertisements for products with reduced prices that do NOT match their website.  Recently, i had 2 power delivery cables fail that i bought about a year ago.... no luck on exchange for warranty purposes.  10 years ago, if i sent an email and it was their product, they would send a replacement free of charge with free shipping.  I know times change and the economic climate has changed, but they should modify their policies and advertisements to be more transparent.

They also advertise a club membership now.... i find it very misleading.  I had a few things in my cart and a popup appeared saying "join" their membership for a year at a set fee and the products in my cart will have "x" as a price (where "x" is the advertised reduced member pricing ), which will pay for your membership fee plus give you the bonus of reduced membership pricing for the next year.  So i started the process and the added savings never matches their projected amounts.  I cancelled and returned to paying the regular sale prices.

Over the last 2 days, i've been arguing over the advertised cost of a miniPC.  THEIR email advertises a 20% sale for PreBlack Friday.    The PC is 459.95 and its CLEARLY written on their email what the price is.   When you click their link, it takes you to their website with a price of 610.  I started a chat on Day 1 and was told the price would change in 24 hours at 10 am.  I logged in today, Day 2, and no reduced price. I spent an hour on chat and was asked to send a pic, forward the email, highlight the advertised price... The chat said they could not see the price reduction... They couldn't see a JPEG image? I could understand if they clicked the hyperlink and the price would come up incorrectly, but they couldn't see the image THEY made on the original email?  Apparently not. After multiple attempts to send a copy of their email, I was eventually offered the ability to buy the product at regular price and then trust them to refund me an adjusted amount.  I didn't take it.  Why trust a company that has shown they can't be trusted?  I asked them to send a link or email to my account to ensure no errors if something occurs to disconnect us.  Guess what... i got disconnected!!  luckily i logged back in and got the same chat person, but that just destroyed my trust and i left their website.  I would avoid Primecables, 123ink, and Shoppersplus, the same company offering different products.

Worst Company and customer service ever.
Slow delivery. Defective products.

At first, they shipped the product two business days instead of one as promised on the website, even though I have emailed them as reminder.

Then, during the assemble process, I found out that a pole and a bolt do not fit. Then the nightmare begins.

After I emailed their customer service, there is no reply for 3 business days while their website states that a reply will only take up to a business day.

After waiting for 3 business days, I finally got a reply, which however is without any substance nor useful:
1. the Tech team suggests me "pull the sync rod out a little, the distance between the lifting columns is based on the crossbeam."; and
2. "The bolt for fixing the motor is C."

For 1, the problem is that a rod is too long and does not fit and also the Assemble Instructions explicitly reminds me to "make sure that the hexagonal post is securely inserted into the base of the column". If I indeed pull out the hexagonal post a little, it won't be securely inserted into the base of the column.

But the so-called "Tech team" told me to just put all things together by completely ignoring the warning of the Assemble Instructions. I then asked whether this will affect the safety of the desk, and unsurprisingly they refused to reply again.

For 2, I am not sure if the Tech Team is teasing me by saying the obvious and assuming that I have used the wrong bolt. I have already sent photos which clearly shows them I have used bolt C and the manual also gives clear instructions.

I have also mentioned that it is not the problem of the bolts. Both bolts can fit into one hole but cannot be screwed into another one. I won't use two different types of bolts for the same type of holes and complain that they don't fit.

To summarize, you are free to try your luck buying this company's products. As long as you are lucky enough, it should be fine, and, according to their Tech Team, even if you encounter any issue with the products, it is your fault because you should not follow the Assembly Instruction.

I ordered an electric desk and received it broken! The motor is broken, only one side goes up and down, and the other one doesn't. Then this has caused other breakages.
I have already wasted a lot of time setting up the desk and taking it down (due to breakage) and on top of that, the service with ShopperPlus is VERY long, it's been 3 days that I'm in communication with them by phone and email and the problem is still not solved!!!
Wouldn't recommend to anyone!  Do not buy with this company!

UPDATE: they accepted to send me another desk after multiple emails and this review.

I'll stick with other shops such as Amazon with much faster shipping. I did get the delivery in the end though
